env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^nested-ok 7 7$'
stdout '^nested-str leaf$'
cd ..

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/nestedtest

go 1.27

-- w/parse/parse.lgo --
package parse

import "comptime"

type Cfg struct {
	Port int
	DB   DBCfg
}

type DBCfg struct {
	Max int
}

func Load[T any](out T) T {
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		Set[f.Type](&out.[f])
	}
	return out
}

func Set[F any](dst *F) {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[F]() {
		const for _, g := range comptime.Fields[F]() {
			Set[g.Type](&dst.[g])
		}
	} else {
		const switch F {
		case int:
			*dst = 7
		}
	}
}

func Kind[F any]() string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[F]() {
		return "struct"
	}
	return "leaf"
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/nestedtest/parse"
	"fmt"
)

func main() {
	cfg := parse.Load[parse.Cfg](parse.Cfg{})
	if cfg.Port != 7 || cfg.DB.Max != 7 {
		fmt.Println("BAD", cfg.Port, cfg.DB.Max)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("nested-ok", cfg.Port, cfg.DB.Max)
	fmt.Println("nested-str", parse.Kind[string]())
}
